unresolvedTerminal: full principal-loss/fees-to-capped-gain interval; no exclusion, last close or automatic observed zero

scopes.E: research-only common stocks not excluded by authenticated as-of ZAD list or as-of owner NO; owner UNKNOWN included; not owner/halal-approved, not a permitted trade
scopes.A: owner-affirmed applicability; valid as-of owner YES and no list exclusion; uncertainty preserved

continue: all mandatory lower bounds >0 in every view with full denominator and other gates; scope-specific; no automatic paper/live authority
stop: any mandatory upper bound <=0 in ANY required view; full denominator condition applies
shareCountPerView: q_view=floor((1000-3)/E_view); E_view is raw entry times (1+entrySlip_view); report q and zero-order counts per view and arm
costOrder: gross return from raw entry/exit prices
apply view slippage to executed entry/exit prices (S2/S3 entry x1.02, exit x0.98)
subtract view friction on invested notional q_view * E_view; idle cash earns zero
